parts.text: How many days of paid outpatient sick leave do I get per year, and what is the deadline to submit a Medical Certificate if I'm out sick for 3 days?

Eligible employees are entitled to 14 days of paid outpatient sick leave per year.
If an employee is on sick leave for 3 consecutive working days or more, a Medical Certificate from a registered medical practitioner must be submitted by the 3rd working day of absence.
